Palma, year 342. The cave in the north hums at night.
Arrow keys or WASD to walk, or just tap where to go. Enter / Space / Z, or tap someone, to talk.
The house behind me is empty now. Look around if you like - the study door sticks.
If the cave scares you, carry a light. The torches never go out down there.

"Four numbers," she whispers. "He always wrote them down."
